title: I built a free all-in-one market research platform (Stocks, Crypto, Bonds, Commodities) and would love feedback from data-driven traders.
author: MSiade
selftext:
Hey r/ai\_trading,

I know how strict Reddit can be about self-promotion, so I want to be completely upfront: 

I’m the solo creator of a financial intelligence platform called Siade Whales (siadewhales.com)

I built this because I was tired of jumping between 5 different tabs to analyze different markets. I wanted a true all-in-one hub. 

The platform covers the markets to the max: **Crypto, Stocks, Bonds, and Commodities**. On top of that, I’ve integrated a live news feed, a full economic calendar, and even a completely **interactive mining map** (which I think is pretty unique).

Since this community is highly focused on algorithms, AI, and heavy data analysis, you guys are exactly the kind of advanced traders whose opinions I value the most.

There is a very robust **completely free version** that gives you access to these tools right away. I’m not here to just drop a link and run, I genuinely want your brutal, honest feedback.

If you have a few minutes to play around with the free version, please let me know:  
 What data points or metrics are missing for your algo/AI strategies?  
 How does the interactive map feel to you?  
 What would you change to make it fit your daily workflow better?

Thanks in advance for your time and feedback!

comments.author: investigatormaker
comments.body:
For this crowd, the first question will probably be whether the data can leave the browser: a CSV export or an API is what an algo strategy actually consumes, so saying plainly whether Siade Whales has one, or plans one, will shape the feedback you get. On the mining map, tying each site to the commodity price or the listed miner's ticker would turn it from a novelty into something a trader opens daily. If there is a paid tier, say up front what sits in the free version, since people here will ask before signing in.
